AI Overview

AI Mode replied:

Childhood asthma is a common chronic lung disease that inflames and narrows the airways, causing recurring coughing, wheezing, and breathing difficulties. 
Common Symptoms
  • Coughing: Constant, worse at night, or triggered by play.
  • Wheezing: A high-pitched whistling sound when exhaling.
  • Shortness of breath: Rapid breathing or stopping play early due to fatigue.
  • Chest tightness: Younger children may say their chest hurts or feels "funny". 
Causes and Triggers
  • Viral infections: The common cold or flu.
  • Allergens:
